n: DM NVX® 5K 4x1 AV-over-IP Switcher Card with HDMI® and USB-C® (DM-NVX-384C)
d: DM-NVX-384C DM NVX® 5K 4x1 AV-over-IP Switcher Card with HDMI® and USB-C® Connectivity

specs.label: Video Codec
specs.value: Encoder: Pixel Perfect Processing (default) or DM-NVX-D10/D20/D200 Series,; H.264 AV-over-IP streaming; Decoder: Pixel Perfect Processing or DM-NVX-D10/D20 Series

specs.label: Video Resolutions
specs.value: Up to 5120x2880 @30 Hz (5K Wide) or 5120x1440 @60 Hz (5K Super‑Wide); Up to 4:4:4 color sampling; HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, and Deep Color support

specs.label: Encoding/Decoding audio formats
specs.value: Primary multichannel (up to 8-channel LPCM or encoded HBR 7.1 surround sound), secondary 2-channel LPCM

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, and 5K support (Dual‑Mode DisplayPort™ interface and DVI compatible) DisplayPort over USB-C (DisplayPort Alt Mode) with HDR10, HDR10+, and 5K support

specs.label: Output Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, and 4K60 4:4:4 support (DVI compatible)

specs.label: Switcher
